meta.title: HTA/TTA - Air Canada 759 taxiway overflight, SFO, 7 July 2017 (input to STPA)
meta.source: NTSB/AIR-18/01, Aircraft Incident Report, adopted 25 Sep 2018

root.title: Control the approach and landing of ACA759 so that the safety constraint is enforced: the aircraft descends toward and lands only on the cleared, unoccupied runway (SFO 28R) and maintains safe separation from aircraft, vehicles and non-runway surfaces

children.title: Build an adequate process model of the destination before departure (YYZ)
Review flight release NOTAMs for SFO (RWY 10R/28L CLSD 2300-0800)
Re-assess relevance of destination NOTAMs after departure delay
Assess crew alertness and fatigue risk before duty (reserve call-out, flight into circadian low)
Prepare the descent and configure navigation guidance (before top of descent)
Obtain and review ATIS Quebec via ACARS (incl. NOTAM 'RWYS 28L, 10R CLSD')
Select RNAV 28R (FMS Bridge Visual) from FMS database
PM: Manually tune ILS 28R (111.7) on MCDU RAD NAV page
Select LS and check ILS identifier on PFDs
PF: Review and verify all MCDU programming made by PM
Conduct arrival, approach and threat briefing
Brief approach procedure, expected runway lighting and visual aids
Identify and brief threats and mitigations (NOTAMs, closed parallel runway, night, alertness)
Agree automation and descent mode strategy (managed vs open descent)
Fly the arrival and initial approach
Manage descent mode and meet altitude constraints
Comply with ATC clearances (direct TRDOW, cleared FMS Bridge Visual, contact tower)
Obtain and read back landing clearance for runway 28R
Configure aircraft for landing (gear down, flaps)
Disconnect autopilot and flight directors at or before F101D
PF: Identify and align with the cleared runway (visual segment after F101D)
Visually identify runway 28R environment (approach lights, edge/centreline lights, PAPI)
Turn 14 deg right at F101D and align with runway 28R centreline
Cross-check lateral alignment against electronic guidance (LOC / LNAV / ND)
Detect and resolve conflicting visual cues (green centreline, yellow guard lights, aircraft lights, no runway markings)
PM: Monitor the approach and support the PF
Set missed approach altitude and heading
Set runway heading bug (on PF request)
Monitor flight path against stabilised approach criteria (1000 ft / 500 ft gates)
Call out deviations and assertively voice concerns to PF
Verify runway status with ATC when cues are ambiguous
Query tower: confirm runway clear / cleared to land
Integrate ATC response with own perception and re-evaluate alignment
Decide on and execute go-around
Recognise go-around criteria (not on centreline, outside touchdown zone, unresolved doubt)
PM: Call 'go-around'
PF: Execute go-around (thrust TOGA, pitch up, climb)
Fly missed approach per ATC instructions and re-set up second approach (incl. ILS)
SFO ATCT: Provide aerodrome control service that enforces runway/taxiway separation
Decide on consolidation of positions (single-person midnight operation)
Set airfield lighting for closed parallel runway configuration
Scan runways, radar and ASSC display for conflicts and aircraft alignment
Respond to pilot queries and third-party transmissions
Issue go-around instruction when misalignment/conflict is detected
Crews on taxiway C: Detect and alert to an approaching aircraft misaligned with the taxiway
Detect arriving aircraft lined up with taxiway C
Transmit warning on tower frequency
Illuminate own aircraft (landing/nose lights) to signal occupied surface
Report the event and preserve safety data (feedback to higher-level controllers)
Flight crew: Report event to dispatch as soon as possible
Flight crew: File Air Safety Report (ASR)
Operator: Remove aircraft from service and preserve CVR/FDR data
ATC: File mandatory occurrence report with correct severity

ttaRecords.consequence: Loss: collision between ACA759 and up to four occupied aircraft on taxiway C (approx. 1000 people at risk). Hazard: aircraft on final aligned with a non-runway / occupied surface (min. 60 ft agl, 10-20 ft vertical separation to PAL115).
ttaRecords.comments: Plan 0: Do 1.1 (preflight) then 1.2 > 1.3 before top of descent; do 1.4 > 1.5 with 1.6 in parallel; do 1.7 if visual cues are ambiguous; do 1.8 if go-around criteria met or doubt unresolved; 1.9 and 1.10 run concurrently (other controllers); do 1.11 after landing. STPA: controllers = PF, PM, ATCT controller, other crews, operator (dispatch/flight ops/safety dept), FAA/Transport Canada. Safety constraint: aircraft must not descend below a safe height unless aligned with the cleared runway.
Plan 1.1: Do 1.1.1 then 1.1.2 whenever schedule changes; 1.1.3 at call-out and report for duty.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Information not retained (NOTAM 'quick scan', closure not recalled)
ttaRecords.recovery: Second opportunity: NOTAM in ATIS Quebec (1.2.1); threat briefing (1.3.2)
ttaRecords.consequence: Crew expects two open parallel runways at SFO - flawed process model of airport configuration
ttaRecords.comments: 27-page release; closure NOTAM on p.8, mid-list among many crane NOTAMs (serial position effect). Tablets did not allow highlighting. Report 1.1, 2.3.1, Fig.10. STPA: inadequate feedback/information to flight crew controller; links to A-18-24.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Check omitted (NOTAM relevance not re-evaluated after 49 min takeoff delay)
ttaRecords.consequence: Closure judged irrelevant because crew believed they would land before 2300
ttaRecords.comments: Original ETA 2303, 3 min after closure. Report 2.2.1. STPA: process model not updated when context (time) changed.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Inadequate assessment (fatigue risk accepted / not mitigated)
ttaRecords.recovery: In-flight 'keep an eye on each other'; controlled rest not feasible
ttaRecords.consequence: Captain awake >19 h, FO >12 h; operating at 0256 body-clock time; increased susceptibility to expectation bias
ttaRecords.comments: Reserve captain notified 1149 EDT, 7 h 51 min notice; compliant with Canadian rules, not with 14 CFR 117. Report 1.2, 2.3.3. STPA: higher-level controller (Transport Canada regulation, operator scheduling) - inadequate control; A-18-29.
Plan 1.2: Do 1.2.1, then 1.2.2 > 1.2.3 > 1.2.4 (PM); then 1.2.5 (PF). All before top of descent.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Information not obtained (closure text in ATIS not detected)
ttaRecords.consequence: Flawed process model persists into approach
ttaRecords.comments: ATIS printed as 14 continuous upper-case lines; closure split over lines 8-9. Received ~2321, low-workload phase. Report 2.2.1, 2.3.1, Fig.11. STPA: feedback channel design (ACARS presentation).

ttaRecords.consequence: Correct procedure selected; database lacked autotune frequency for this approach
ttaRecords.comments: Only approach in AC A320 database requiring manual navaid tuning (database from United Airlines, no autotune frequency). Report 1.1 fn14. STPA: automation (FMS) controller design flaw; A-18-23.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Omission (ILS frequency not entered)
ttaRecords.consequence: No localizer / extended centreline on PFD/ND - no independent lateral feedback during visual segment
ttaRecords.comments: Unusual step; instruction 'Tune the ILS 28R' embedded mid-paragraph on chart page 2 (low salience). FDR confirms no frequency entered. Report 2.2.2, Fig.9. STPA UCA: 'Tune ILS' not provided by PM.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Check omitted (LS not selected, missing ident not noticed)
ttaRecords.consequence: Absence of ILS data on PFDs not detected
ttaRecords.comments: Absence of information is hard to detect. AC procedure for this approach did not require LS selection. Report 1.1 fn15.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Check omitted (PF did not verify RAD NAV page)
ttaRecords.consequence: Error from 1.2.3 not trapped; redundancy of two-pilot cross-check lost
ttaRecords.comments: SOP required PF review of all MCDU programming. Report 2.2.2. STPA: missing cross-check between controllers (PF-PM) - coordination flaw.
Plan 1.3: First item on pre-descent checklist. PM starts threat identification, PF ends; do 1.3.1 > 1.3.2 > 1.3.3.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Incomplete action (expected lighting configuration not briefed)
ttaRecords.consequence: Crew not primed to notice absence of 28L lights or unusual surface lighting
ttaRecords.comments: After the event AC amended briefing to include expected approach/runway lighting and visual aids (Appendix B).

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Omission (runway 28L closure not identified as threat)
ttaRecords.consequence: Threat not proactively mitigated (top TEM level failed); information not made accessible for later recall
ttaRecords.comments: Briefed: night, traffic, busy airspace, terrain, alertness. Threat card listed NOTAMS and Lighting. Report 2.2.5.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Communication omitted (descent mode not discussed)
ttaRecords.consequence: Diverging mental models of automation state between PF and PM; increased PM workload
ttaRecords.comments: FO perceived open descent and was uncomfortable; captain stated managed after catching up. Report 1.1, 2.2.3. STPA: inconsistent process models between controllers.
Plan 1.4: Do 1.4.1 continuously; 1.4.2 and 1.4.3 as ATC instructs; 1.4.4 per profile; 1.4.5 at or before F101D.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Inappropriate mode (open descent after vectoring)
ttaRecords.consequence: PM attention absorbed by constraint monitoring and missed approach setup
ttaRecords.comments: Allowed by procedure; most AC pilots would fly managed. Report 2.2.3.

ttaRecords.consequence: Clearances complied with
ttaRecords.comments: Cleared for approach 2346:30; tower contact 2351:07.

ttaRecords.consequence: Landing clearance 28R received 2351:11 at 3500 ft
ttaRecords.comments: Clearance correct; the crew's belief about which surface was 28R was wrong.

ttaRecords.consequence: Gear down 2352:46
AP off 2353:28 (1300 ft), FDs off 2354:02 (1200 ft) - aircraft now manually flown with only visual references
ttaRecords.comments: Procedure-compliant, but with no ILS tuned there was no electronic lateral feedback after this point.
Plan 1.5: Do 1.5.1 > 1.5.2; then 1.5.3 continuously until touchdown; do 1.5.4 whenever cues conflict; if unresolved go to 1.7 or 1.8.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Wrong identification (28R perceived as 28L, taxiway C perceived as 28R)
ttaRecords.recovery: Cross-check with guidance (1.5.3); PM monitoring; ATC
ttaRecords.consequence: Hazardous state: aircraft aligned with occupied taxiway C
ttaRecords.comments: Expectation bias from previous SFO experience (never seen 28L dark); 28L lights off; construction light plants on 28L; aircraft lights on C in straight line; 28L 'X' marker not in field of view and 0.2 Hz flash. Report 2.3.1-2.3.2. STPA: flawed process model of PF; A-18-28.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Right action on wrong object (aligned with taxiway C)
ttaRecords.consequence: UCA: 'Align with landing surface' provided on wrong surface; descent continued toward occupied taxiway
ttaRecords.comments: At F101D, 2354:28, 1100 ft, 3.6 nm from seawall. PAPI for 28R (left side) still gave plausible glidepath, reinforcing belief.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Check not possible / omitted (no LOC tuned, LNAV not used as cross-check)
ttaRecords.consequence: No independent, dissimilar feedback on lateral position
ttaRecords.comments: Preceding DAL521 had same confusion and resolved it via LNAV guidance. No RAAS/SmartLanding fitted; simulation shows 'Caution Taxiway' at 235 ft, 0.43 nm. Report 1.1.1, 1.5.2, 2.3.4. STPA: missing feedback/sensor; A-18-25, A-18-26.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Information misinterpreted (guard lights interpreted as aircraft on runway; green centreline not acted on)
ttaRecords.consequence: Belief persisted despite contradicting cues
ttaRecords.comments: Crew recalled green centreline lights. Absence of runway features (TDZ, edge lights) hard to detect. Fatigue reduces ability to adapt to new information. Report 2.3.2.1.
Plan 1.6: Do 1.6.1 after AP disconnect; 1.6.2 on PF request; 1.6.3 continuously; 1.6.4 whenever deviation or doubt is detected. Head-down tasks must not prevent 1.6.3 during visual segment.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action at inappropriate time (head-down during critical alignment)
ttaRecords.consequence: PM not monitoring when aircraft aligned with taxiway
ttaRecords.comments: Appropriate given perceived open descent; info had to be read from chart. Set 2355:00. Report 2.2.3.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Task delayed (difficulty finding runway heading on chart)
ttaRecords.consequence: Prolonged head-down time after F101D
ttaRecords.comments: Late PF request at F101D took FO by surprise; indicates insufficient preparation. Report 2.2.5.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Monitoring omitted / too late
ttaRecords.consequence: FO looked up only when asked to call tower; accepted alignment as correct
ttaRecords.comments: FO expected captain to align with intended runway (trust/complacency). Stabilised approach criteria (lateral on centreline) could not be verified electronically. Report 2.2.3, 2.3.2.2.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Communication omitted (concern about descent mode not voiced; doubt about lights not escalated as go-around)
ttaRecords.consequence: Weak cross-monitoring between PF and PM
ttaRecords.comments: CRM competency: PM to communicate all ambiguities assertively. Crew had not yet received 'Understanding Gut Feel' (LIVE) training. Report 1.6.5, 2.2.5, 2.3.4.
Plan 1.7: Do 1.7.1 as soon as ambiguity is perceived; then 1.7.2. If doubt remains, do 1.8 without waiting.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action too late (query delayed ~38 s by frequency congestion)
ttaRecords.consequence: Query made at 300 ft, 0.66 nm; ATC reply at 200 ft - little time left to reconcile
ttaRecords.comments: Combined local/ground frequency busy for 61 s before query. Report 2.5.1. STPA: control loop delay in communication channel.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Information misinterpreted ('no one on 28R' taken as confirmation of alignment)
ttaRecords.recovery: Cues near seawall; taxiway crew warnings
ttaRecords.consequence: Approach continued to 100 ft over UAL1
ttaRecords.comments: Query asked about runway status, not about own alignment; ATC answer true but did not address the actual hazard. STPA: feedback that is correct but semantically mismatched with controller's need.
Plan 1.8: If any criterion in 1.8.1 is met, do 1.8.2 and 1.8.3 immediately (early, especially in confusion - SAFO 17010); then 1.8.4.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action too late (recognition only over airport surface)
ttaRecords.consequence: Minimal safety margins; overflight of UAL1 at 100 ft
ttaRecords.comments: Triggering cues within 6 s (2355:59-2356:05): UAL1 transmissions, PAL115 lights, own landing lights showing aircraft. Report 2.3.2.2.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action too late
ttaRecords.consequence: Callout coincided with PF action
ttaRecords.comments: FO called go-around because he could not resolve what he saw.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action too late (TOGA at 89 ft, 0.11 nm beyond seawall)
ttaRecords.consequence: Collision avoided; min. 60 ft agl over PAL115, 10-20 ft vertical separation
ttaRecords.comments: Crew later believed go-around was at ~400 ft and did not see aircraft below - perception of severity distorted. Report 1.1, 2.2.4. STPA UCA: go-around provided too late.

ttaRecords.consequence: ILS tuned for second approach; uneventful landing 0011
ttaRecords.comments: Shows that the control action (tune ILS) was feasible and effective once prompted.
Plan 1.9: Do 1.9.1 based on traffic forecast; 1.9.2 when configuration changes; 1.9.3 continuously; 1.9.4 on any transmission; 1.9.5 immediately when conflict detected.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action too early (positions combined at 2349 while LUAW still in use)
ttaRecords.consequence: Frequency congestion; NCT not informed of single-person operation
ttaRecords.comments: SOP had no staffing rules 2200-0630; after event: no combining before 0015. Report 1.4.1, 2.5.1. STPA: ATC organisational controller.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Inadequate setting (approach light intensity/SFL not adapted to closed parallel runway)
ttaRecords.consequence: Weaker visual definition of landing runway 28R
ttaRecords.comments: Lighting met regulations; DAL521 captain stated sequenced flashers would have defined the runway. After event: +1 step approach light intensity when adjacent arrival runway closed. Report 1.4.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Detection not possible (misalignment not visible due to parallax; ASSC gave no alert)
ttaRecords.consequence: Controller unaware of hazardous state until ~0.1 nm final
ttaRecords.comments: ASSC safety logic not designed for taxiway arrivals; ACA759 data block dropped out for 12 s. Report 1.4.2, 2.5.2. STPA: missing sensor/feedback for ATC controller; A-18-27.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Information misinterpreted (unidentified 'where is that guy going?' seemed out of context)
ttaRecords.consequence: Few seconds delay in recognising conflict
ttaRecords.comments: Controller had just scanned 28R twice and answered ACA759 correctly within 1 s. Report 2.2.4.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action too late (relative to need; appropriate once aware)
ttaRecords.consequence: Go-around instruction at 2356:09, after aircraft was already climbing
ttaRecords.comments: NTSB: controller responded appropriately once aware. STPA UCA: 'Go around' provided too late due to missing feedback.
Plan 1.10: Informal, unplanned control loop. Do 1.10.1; if misalignment detected do 1.10.2 and 1.10.3 in parallel.

ttaRecords.consequence: UAL1 saw ACA759 1-2 miles out, expected it to correct
ttaRecords.comments: Report 1.1.2.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Non-standard phraseology / no callsign
ttaRecords.consequence: Warning reached controller but was initially not understood; ACA759 crew did not register it
ttaRecords.comments: STPA: unofficial feedback path that turned out to be decisive.

ttaRecords.consequence: Illuminated taxiway and UAL1; likely one of the cues triggering go-around
ttaRecords.comments: PAL115 and UAL863. Report 2.3.2.2.
Plan 1.11: Do 1.11.1 immediately after landing (ACARS possible); 1.11.2 when time permits; operator does 1.11.3 on notification; ATC does 1.11.4 promptly.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action too late (~16 h) and severity understated ('wrong runway')
ttaRecords.recovery: TSB e-mail to operator on 9 July
ttaRecords.consequence: Operator unaware of severity; crew flew return sector; aircraft kept in service
ttaRecords.comments: 'As soon as possible' was undefined. Report 1.6.4, 2.4. STPA: feedback to operator (higher-level controller) delayed and degraded.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Action delayed (ASR stuck on tablet without Wi-Fi)
ttaRecords.consequence: Safety department received report 10-11 July
ttaRecords.comments: Report 1.6.4.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Omission (aircraft not removed from service; safety dept not consulted)
ttaRecords.consequence: CVR overwritten (2 h recorder); evidence lost; ~40 h further flying
ttaRecords.comments: Flight ops decided without safety department. Report 1.6.4, 2.4. STPA: organisational control loop.

ttaRecords.externalErrorMode: Severity understated (reported as go-around, not flagged significant)
ttaRecords.consequence: Regulator/operator notification delayed
ttaRecords.comments: MOR entered ~0125; see Member Weener statement. Report 1.4.1.
